newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Marine to maintain profit level.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Marine to maintain profit level.

text.p: Keppel Marine Industries Ltd, part of the Keppel Corp group, said on Thursday it expects competition to depress margins in the current year.
The company, which specialises in ship repairs and shipbuilding, however said it expects to maintain 1997 profit at the same level as 1996.
The group had just announced a 42.8 percent fall in net profit to Singapore $15.2 million for the year ending December 31, 1996.
